notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings, Dreamers!

We've got a small patch going out for Etherborn today fixing some bugs and adding some quality of life improvements!

Patch 1.0.3 Notes:
· Removed incorrectly allowed button remapping options.
· Improved changes between controllers.
· Improved audio banks management, fixing some SFX not unloading between certain levels.
· Fixed some audio issues on the menus.
· Fixed some UI issues on the menus.
· Fixed saved camera Game Options not being applied correctly when changing between levels or loading a saved game.
· Fixed a movement physics force being framerate-dependent.
· Fixed the reseted orientation of items after dying.
· Fixed visual camera issues in level "Desert of the Mind".
· Added general minor improvements and adjustments.
· Added general stability and optimization improvements.
· Added Akupara Games as publisher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32447826/3a9da379f06c89dccb6e89bbfb245dd1463a82b5.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 & Japan re-release
notes.content:
Hello!

Today we're releasing an update for the game, with general improvements, options additions and bug fixes that we've been working on these last weeks.

We're also doing a re-release for Japan with this update too! We're improving the Japanese support in the game, as we've added newly re-localized Japanese texts (done by Kakehashi Games) and improving the font system too to fix certain issues.

Thanks as always to everyone that has played the game and for all your comments and support!

If you enjoy the game think about leaving a review here, as it will help us a lot!


Patch Notes:
1.0.2
. Added new Japanese re-localization.
· Fixed the Japanese font sometimes showing wrong characters.
· Fixed localization errors in Spanish and Catalan.
· Improved the subtitle size system.
· Added voice volume control in Options.
· Increased range of the camera view rotation.
· Fixed a bug in the respawn system of level "Shapes of a Memory".
· Improved the respawn system of level "Longing of the Stones".
· Fixed the configuration of a switch system in level "Structured Thoughts".
· Fixed an issue with the levels game state when finishing the game.
· Fixed occasional audio glitches when changing between levels.
· Improved screen fading when changing between levels.
· Improved orientation of collected orbs when following the player.
· Added general minor improvements and adjustments.
· Improved general performance.

notes.title: Reviews Round-up and Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/9bc0c7faf73f137627d1d9889daa6eb3f66346d0.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 

In case you missed it, Etherborn launched last week! Have you played it already? With the launch now behind us, we can take a bit of a breather and see what the reaction was (launch day is a crazy event - sooo many things going around. It was terrific and terrifying at the same time). One of the things we couldn’t stop doing was looking for and reading impressions and reviews of Etherborn. Your heart stops for that split second when you notice a new review pop up. Below are a few review quotes that we wanted to share with you.

[i]“It’s a carefully directed, genuinely beautiful game well worth your time.”[/i]
- [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2019/07/18/etherborn-review/]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]

[i]“Like a dream you can’t quite make sense of, but don’t want to end.”[/i]
- [url=https://kotaku.com/forget-everything-you-know-about-gravity-in-this-beauti-1836498782]Kotaku[/url]

[i]“The level design is simply magnificent and, above all, manages to surprise the player.”[/i]
- I[url=https://es.ign.com/etherborn-xbox-one/152749/review/analisis-de-etherborn-para-ps4-one-switch-y-pc]GN España[/url]

[i]"Etherborn is one of the most unique puzzles games I’ve had the pleasure of playing in recent years."[/i]
- [url=https://www.geek.com/games/review-etherborn-is-2019s-trippiest-puzzle-game-1796803/]Geek[/url]

[i]“The real puzzle in Etherborn is the design of the levels. The use of gravity and twisting of the laws of physics as a way to solve everything in front of us is a fantastic element that works really well.”[/i]
- [url=https://www.hobbyconsolas.com/reviews/analisis-etherborn-ps4-xbox-one-nintendo-switch-pc-456395]Hobby Consolas[/url]

We also wanted to let you know that we are working on a few patches and updates, making Etherborn just that bit better and cleaner. They will be popping up soon. 

And lastly, we want to say a big thank you for your support. Seeing so many positive user reviews is humbling and satisfying. Thank you so much for the positive words. And please, if you have a moment, do leave a Steam review of our game. User reviews help in discoverability, and as an indie studio, we would love to get as much of it as possible. It helps us stay afloat. 

Once again, thank you for all your support and we will speak soon!


Regards, 

Carles and Michal | Altered Matter Team

notes.title: An update on our release date
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/4d2aca2de52a6897b0430da906da3432424892ce.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

First up, we have to admit that we’ve been a bit quiet lately on our end when it comes to announcing our release date. For that, we want to say thank you for being patient, and apologies for not saying anything sooner.

[b]We won’t be making the Spring date as we mentioned in our latest announcement.[/b] We’ve been hard at work and have actually completed the game, and we are now dealing with the submission to the console platforms.

However, we’ve decided to hold on the release for just a bit longer. The end of May to the end of June period is a complicated time to release a game. The reason being - having E3 and the Steam Summer Sale happening one after the other.

Since we are a small title, it would be harder to get journalists to cover and review our game, and for people to pay notice to us with one of the biggest gaming shows taking place at the same time (damn you Call of Duty). And with Steam Summer Sale offering crazy deals to gamers, having our game at full price compete with some heavily discounted titles could put us in a bit of a disadvantaged spot as well (damn you GTA V and Witcher 3).

So for these reasons, we will postpone our release - but by not much longer. And as a matter of fact, [b]we will announce our definitive release date really soon[/b] (*cough* *cough* #KFGE3Showcase).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/479c5179f427c1b48c0206e332dc0428bc607645.jpg[/img]

We hope you understand our position. We want to have the best possible launch, and these extra weeks will also serve to have more time to prepare everything without rushing. It seems that this is the best chance in making sure that these years of work pay off in the end. We hope you understand that.

And as always, if you have any questions, ask us away on [url=https://www.facebook.com/EtherbornGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Etherborn]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/etherborn_game/]Instagram[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/dfDx4nn]Discord[/url].


Until next time (when we announce the release date :) )

Michal | Altered Matter Team

notes.title: BIC Fest 2018 Award Finalists and Game Localisation
notes.content:
Hello there!

We’re doing this a bit late, but we wanted to share the news anyway! A few weeks ago Etherborn was part of the BIC Fest 2018 in Busan - South Korea, and we're very proud and happy to say that we were a finalist in no less than 4 different awards!

[u]Etherborn was nominated in these categories:[/u]
Grand Prix
Excellence In Art
Excellence In Experimental
Excellence In Game Design

Other great games such as Wattam and Bossgard took away the prizes, but we're very glad to have been considered for these! It's a big honor for us to share these shows with all these amazing games, and for our ideas to get this kind of recognition. :)

You can read about the awards and check the other games in the [url=http://www.bicfest.org/en/?c=123] BIC Fest website[/url].

And some images of our game in the show.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/bae6845a6885181b01298f1c54b7033c4e8231dd.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/a756bc1c8a407db3c8d9be2e555f939ba7b6ab88.jpg[/img]

[h1]Languages[/h1]
On a kind of related note, since the festival was held in South Korea, we wanted to have a more localised version available there. So we managed to prepare a demo with South Korean text and subtitles on time.

In the last weeks, we’ve been working on the localisation to other languages as well, and we're very happy to say that the game is already (almost) translated to English, Spanish, Catalan, German, French, Italian, Russian, South Korean, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

As a reminder, the game also features full audio in English, Spanish, and Catalan.

A few work-in-progress captures:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/c9e693093a7d0772d80b301b92098acb6e03432b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/db5d0d0a1d61cc56e687bf5f5f19eb4168a32cfe.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/9a6346c53b10227e77854b72d702842983779288.jpg[/img]

This is all for the moment! We'll keep sharing more news, so follow us on [url=twitter.com/Etherborn]Twitter [/url] or like us on [url=facebook.com/EtherbornGame] Facebook [/url] for all your day to day updates or join our own Discord server with Fig-only channels as well. And be sure to wishlist the game on the Etherborn Steam page.


Until next time, 

- ALTERED MATTER
